en: A black and white historical postcard showing a military parade or review in a town square. Large groups of soldiers stand at attention, while civilians, including women and children, line the square and look on. The buildings are decorated with flags, including French and American flags, visible from the windows. The right side of the postcard features printed text in both French and English, providing information about the scene depicted.
